sample_unit: inpatient cases with clinician-defined key facts

links.outcome: Agreement of LLM Jury with seven-physician majority vote on key-fact inclusion in generated summaries
links.effect: LLM Jury achieved Cohen's κ = 81% with the physician panel, statistically non-inferior to a single human expert (κ = 67%, P < 0.001).
links.quote: The MedFactEval LLM Jury achieved almost perfect agreement with this panel (Cohen's κ = 81%), a performance statistically non-inferior to that of a single human expert (κ = 67%, P < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: LLM-jury (multi-LLM majority vote) automated fact-grounded evaluation of generated clinical summaries using clinician-defined key facts
Multi-step model-agnostic agentic workflow for generating factual discharge summaries

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating an automated safeguard/quality assurance evaluation framework (MedFactEval using an LLM jury) against a multi-physician gold standard for checking factual accuracy of clinical discharge summaries.

primary.practice: LLM jury factual evaluation framework (MedFactEval) for quality assurance
